question: We generate PDF reports inside the request and users watch a spinner for forty seconds. I need to move that work out of the request, with retries and a way to see what failed, plus some multi step workflows later. Node on a normal cloud. Which service would you use, and what else did you consider?
summary: Start with an event-triggered PDF function and a recoverable failure. Keep local development, cloud signing credentials and account setup as separate observations.

items.title: Follow one function from event to completed artifact
items.finding: The scan found an ai.txt file without the procedural markers it expects and did not confirm OAuth registration or programmatic provisioning. Inngest documents environment signing keys and a local development mode without them; OAuth registration is not a prerequisite for this SDK task.
items.nextStep: Have the agent create a PDF function using a durable step. First test locally, then repeat in an authorized cloud environment with the required credentials.
items.validation: Record the event, function execution, failed step, retry and output artifact. Do not treat a local run as proof of cloud onboarding.

sources.note: Event-triggered functions use durable steps with automatic retries.
Cloud signing keys belong to environments; local Dev Server does not require one.

items.title: Record the cloud account handoff separately
items.finding: The signup page needs JavaScript and its form gates were unmeasurable to our HTTP reader. This is not evidence that a browser-assisted signup or an existing account cannot work.
items.nextStep: If cloud signup is part of the agreed task, observe it in the chosen browser-capable tool; otherwise provide an authorized account before timing integration.
items.validation: Record any human handoff and its reason. Do not ask for server-rendered signup or weaker gates solely to change this score.

sources.note: Signup URL reached by the scan.
Cloud signing keys belong to environments; local Dev Server does not require one.
